args.content_digest: Section 3: Provider irrevocably assigns to Client all right, title, and interest, including all intellectual property rights, in the Work Product.
Section 4: During the term and for twelve (12) months after expiration or termination, neither party shall directly solicit for employment any employee or contractor of the other party.
Section 5: Provider shall maintain CGL insurance of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence and cyber liability insurance of not less than $5,000,000, naming Client as an additional insured.
Section 6: Client may, on fifteen (15) days' written notice and not more than once in any twelve-month period, audit Provider's books and records.
Section 7: Either party may terminate this Agreement or any SOW for convenience, without cause and without penalty, upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice.
Section 8: For ninety (90) days after any expiration or termination, Provider shall provide transition assistance, including data export and knowledge-transfer sessions.
Section 9: Each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid or payable by Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
Section 9: The cap shall not apply to Provider's breach of confidentiality obligations or IP infringement indemnity, as to which Provider's liability is uncapped and unlimited.
